messages.content: Resuelve problemas de palabras paso a paso.
El tren A sale de la ciudad X a 60 km/h hacia el este. El tren B sale de la ciudad Y (300 km al este) a 80 km/h hacia el oeste, 30 minutos después. ¿Cuándo y dónde se encuentran?

message.content:
<think>We need to solve a relative motion problem: Two trains moving towards each other, starting from points separated by 300 km. Train A moves east from city X at 60 km/h. Train B leaves city Y (which is 300 km east of X) at 80 km/h towards the west, but 30 minutes later (i.e., delayed departure). We need to find when and where they meet.

Interpretation: City X at position 0. City Y is at position +300 km (east). Train A leaves X heading east (+ direction) at speed v_A = 60 km/h. Train B leaves Y heading west (i.e., negative direction) at speed v_B = 80 km/h, but starts 30 minutes (0.5 hour) after Train A.

We need to find time t_meet measured from departure of Train A (i.e., from t=0). Train B starts at t = 0.5 h.

Let x_A(t) = 60 * t (since moving east from X). Let x_B(t) = 300 - 80 * (t - 0.5) for t >= 0.5 (since after B starts). They meet when x_A(t) = x_B(t). For t >= 0.5.

Set 60 t = 300 - 80 (t - 0.5) = 300 - 80t + 40 = 340 - 80t.

Thus 60 t + 80 t = 340 => 140 t = 340 => t = 340/140 = 34/14 = 17/7 ≈ 2.428571... hours after departure of Train A. That's about 2 hours + 0.428571*60 = 2 hours + 25.714 minutes = 2 h 25 min 42.86 sec.

Check that t >= 0.5, yes.

Now location: x_meet = 60 * t = 60 * (17/7) = (1020/7) km ≈ 145.714 km east of X. Alternatively, from Y: distance from Y = 300 - x_meet = 300 - (1020/7) = (2100/7 - 1020/7) = 1080/7 ≈ 154.286 km west of Y.

Check relative speeds: closure speed = 60 + 80 = 140 km/h. Starting separation 300
